spring-rest-sakila

A REST API service providing comprehensive access to the Sakila sample database—a MySQL database modeling a DVD rental store company. The service exposes CRUD operations and complex queries on films, actors, customers, rentals, payments, stores, and staff through RESTful endpoints. It demonstrates enterprise patterns including authentication with JWT, caching via Redis, proper layering with Spring Data JPA, and comprehensive API documentation.

🕐 Generated September 10, 2026 at 01:21 AM UTC
Technology Stack: Spring Boot Web Spring Data JPA Spring HATEOAS Spring Security Spring REST Docs Lombok QueryDSL Blaze Persistence MapStruct MySQL Connector JWT (JJWT) Redis Prometheus Gradle
The application follows a layered architecture organized into domain modules (actor, film, customer, location, payment, rental, staff, store/inventory, and auth), each with controller, service, repository, and DTO layers. Controllers handle HTTP requests and enforce role-based security. Services provide business logic with transactional boundaries. Repositories use Spring Data JPA with custom implementations leveraging QueryDSL and Blaze Persistence for complex queries. Representation model assemblers implement the HAL/HATEOAS pattern for hypermedia responses. Shared infrastructure includes JWT authentication, Redis caching, logging with MDC, and centralized exception handling. MapStruct mappers facilitate entity-to-DTO conversions.
Domain Modules: actor film customer location payment rental staff store auth common
